game.title: Dallas Cowboys at Green Bay Packers

lede: Dallas Cowboys carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play), while Green Bay Packers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#22 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Green Bay Packers -1.1 with a fair total of 51.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Green Bay Packers pass offence vs Dallas Cowboys pass defence, which sits +0.270 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Dallas Cowboys and Green Bay Packers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
